verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships its own background automation: monitors automatically check connected systems, integrations refresh data up to daily, and the platform collects evidence and alerts on violations without user action. However, these are fixed, built-in compliance monitors enabled by connecting tools. Nothing shows a user defining their own automations, triggers or schedules, and the MCP server is user-invoked through an assistant rather than autonomous. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation/workflow builder, custom triggers and schedules, autonomous agent-driven background tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Monitors automatically check your connected systems (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP) for compliance with the control's requirements.
Monitors and integrations will be refreshing data up to daily or ad-hoc
Thoropass collects compliance-relevant data automatically, keeping you audit-ready and alerting you to compliance violations
High-quality data automatically satisfies evidence requests while powering transparent continuous compliance monitors.
Remind you to to start your reviews according to your policy's timelines... Automate the gathering of evidence for audits (when applicable).
